title: Thousands rally to save Bengaluru’s Lalbagh, oppose tunnel road project
summary: Thousands congregated at Lalbagh Botanical Park in Bengaluru on August 31, 2026 to oppose the Parks Amendment Bill.

title: Vande Mataram politics returns to centre stage in Keralam as Onam festivities end
summary: A choir renders six-stanza version of the song at conclusion of Keralam govt-sponsored Onam week pageantry, flagged off by Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan in front of Lok Bhavan on Sunday evening, re-igniting the controversy. The flag-off ceremony marked a departure from State government’s decision not to sing Vande Mataram in full during Independence Day celebrations
